evals.prompt: Apply a revision plan to the paper and results, then re-validate and report per-item status.
evals.expected_output: Success returns execution_report.json with per-item pass/fail after re-running the consistency gate.
assertions: applies each revision_plan item to its target file
updates both paper/main.tex and figures/all_results.json as required
re-runs the consistency-checker gate after edits
reports a per-item pass/fail status with evidence
does not mark the report complete when any hard gate fails
